calendar_climatology.sign_convention: difference = brier(calendar_climatology) - brier(persistence_logistic) on each scored day; a positive mean means persistence_logistic had the lower Brier score, so it beat the benchmark on these days

information_set.decision_instant: decision_time on the panel day before the scored day

unavailable.log_score: the forecast assigned probability 0 to an event that occurred, so the mean negative log likelihood is infinite. It is not clipped: a clip replaces an infinite loss with a finite one chosen by whoever picked the clip, and hides the failure worth seeing
